PoE Injector BN060-P12024 (24V, 0.5A - 12W) | Reliable Power for IP Cameras & Access Points

The PoE Injector BN060-P12024 is an efficient and compact Power over Ethernet (PoE) solution designed to power IP cameras, access points, and other PoE-enabled network devices using a single Ethernet cable. With an output of 24V DC at 0.5A (12W), it is perfect for powering devices in small to medium-sized network installations. This passive PoE injector supports 10/100Mbps data rates, ensuring smooth data transfer along with reliable power delivery.

Key Features:

  • 24V DC Output: Delivers stable 24V DC at 0.5A (12W) for powering IP cameras, access points, and other PoE devices.
  • Passive PoE Technology: Provides both power and data over a single Ethernet cable, reducing wiring complexity.
  • Compact Design: Small and lightweight, making it ideal for indoor installations in tight spaces.
  • Supports 10/100Mbps: Compatible with devices requiring standard Ethernet speeds, ensuring reliable data transmission.
  • Wide Device Compatibility: Works seamlessly with IP cameras, wireless access points, and VoIP phones that support passive PoE.
  • Energy Efficient: With a 12W output, this injector ensures energy-saving performance without compromising on power delivery.
  • Easy Setup: Plug-and-play installation for quick deployment in home or office networks.
